Case: Patient D is a 45-year-old Asian man with hepatocellular carcinoma status-post C4-C5 corpectomy and fusion 8 months ago who presents with new arm and leg pain. When describing the pain, he says that he feels intermittent shocks down both arms and legs, and also notes a diffuse ache in his neck and lower back. MRI of scans of his entire spine show increased tumor burden in his lumbar and cervical spine causing multiple areas of severe stenosis. You are also able to identify new lesions seeding his peritoneum.
